items.description: A portable, scoped agent memory.
🐨 The cloud for your team's agents. Save your agent memory, credentials, code, and automations, portable across every agent with Kody.
An optimized, robust implementation of A-MEM (Agentic Memory) engineered for resource-constrained edge models, featuring validated evolution and dynamic bi-directional retrieval.

Your AI forgets every session. Give it a memory it can trust: local-first, review-gated agent memory — one SQLite vault for DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP client, with an immutable audit log and a token ledger. Open source, self-hosted, no cloud.
Version-controlled memory for AI agents — Doltgres-backed, MCP-native. Human notes in Obsidian, agent memory in flint.
Short term long term AI agent memory system using fine-tuning, priors, and RAG.

A private, local-first notes and productivity app with a built-in AI that runs on your own computer: honest idea critique, AI agent memory, P2P sync, and a 3D galaxy graph of your notes. Rust + Tauri + React.
Skirnir: a self-hosted LLM router and AI gateway for Ollama, with OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility, GPU-aware routing, cloud fallback, and optional shared agent memory.

This repository contains my practice codes and projects developed while learning LangChain. It showcases experiments with prompts, chains, agents, memory, retrievers, and integrations with different LLM providers. The goal is to document my learning journey, provide reusable examples, and build a foundation for future AI/LLM applications.
Agent memory: one binary, hybrid recall, hooks + CLI + MCP
Cognitive architecture for persistent AI agent memory. Knowledge graph with learning retrieval, ACT-R decay, and spreading activation. Markdown-native, local-first, zero cloud. MCP server + CLI.
WIP : An evolving intelligence system using Agentic Memory Layer following Semantic Space Time concepts

Project Observatory by PassionCode.ai — a local dashboard and Mac app for the projects your agents work on: Git activity, findings, agent memory over MCP and known-key exposure. Signed releases that update themselves. AGPL-3.0 or commercial.
Seven practical skills for Claude Code and Codex, with local Agent Memory and illustrated guides.

Open-source cross-agent memory layer for coding agents via MCP. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Oh-my-Pi, Pi, Copilot, Kiro, OpenCode, and Trae.
Compiled agents-memory macOS arm64 previews and opt-in Claude Code plugin marketplace; no private Python implementation.
Self-hosted multi-user agent memory over MCP (Python + FastMCP)
Cloudflare Agent Memory provider for Hermes Agent

Agent platform in Kotlin: JSONL event bus, hybrid RAG over pgvector (cosine + tsquery, RRF), agent memory with LLM extraction and decay, evals with recall gates, and a ZCode MCP plugin — orchestrated on KAP
Agent memory for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex: MCP server + Graph RAG over your Obsidian or markdown notes, a search layer for a Karpathy-style LLM Wiki. Wikilinks are the graph, SQLite the only store.
Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarm Orchestrator & Task Mesh with ReAct reflection loops, vector episodic memory, tool sandboxing, and real-time visualizer.
🧠 Curated & live-monitored directory of open-source cognitive architectures, episodic memory engines, world models, and embodiment frameworks for Sentient & Autonomous AI (Updated Daily).
Episodes: an open format for episodic memory — what happened, from whose standpoint, when and where
Reliability-aware episodic memory for LLM agents: preventing error propagation from unreliable past experiences
Long-Term Episodic Memory & Knowledge Graph Engine for AI Agents
Deterministic Cyclic Agent Workflow & Experience Reflector (Plan -> Act -> Verify -> Reflect) with Qdrant Episodic Memory
Universal episodic memory engine (Chrono + DocTree + Vector + HippoRAG PPR + Bundle) with ACT-R power-law decay for .NET 10
A comprehensive relational memory system for AI, which includes short term, long term, and episodic memory, and the right to forget via both redaction and memory decay.

KnowSWE: Experience-Augmented, Evidence-Guided Repository Debugging for Small Language Models. Research on budget-aware fault localization, progressive code exploration, and episodic memory using Gemma without fine-tuning.
Time-loop reinforcement learning study: an agent learns from lived episodic memory to escape a resetting island, with pre-registered controls.
High-throughput episodic memory for local CPU LLMs via data-dependent LSH (ITQ) and POPCNT scan
Preliminary exploration of surprise-based test-time adaptation of a low-rank episodic memory tensor for robot foundation models (VLAs at first).
Local-first companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness: persona, episodic memory, mood, and a web room.

A Chrome Extension that intercepts read content, generates semantic embeddings locally, and stores them in an offline vector database (IndexedDB). It replaces traditional keyword history search with a natural language semantic search. Create a completely private, offline, searchable memory bank of all consumed web text.
Hierarchical zero-storage episodic memory, procedural attractor clustering, and O(1) coordinate anchoring for Hermes Agent (Nous Research Plugin v2).
[NeurIPS26] Official Implementation for STEMFly: Enhancing UAV Vision-Language Navigation via Sensor Grounding, Temporal Diversity and Episodic Memory

Multi-tier orchestrator with director, project manager, and coding agents. Runs Claude Code, Grok Build, and Codex alone or together in Collab mode, where they split roles and coordinate over a real-time message bus. Built-in MCP server, long-term memory through Recallium, plus its own episodic memory and memory distillation.
Telegram persona runtime with episodic memory, affect (PAD + appraisal), social pain, rumination, circadian sleep and sleep-time consolidation. In active development.
